title: Tech Note: Enrich UX and UI with Unicode Special Characters
author: Add Komoncharoensiri, Director of Technical Services, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: Unicode/emoji handling in 4D via Char, multi-style spans, and Listbox/button icon techniques remains fully valid today; this is a UI craftsmanship how-to with no dependency on any deprecated 4D feature.
related_updates: No 4D feature used here has been deprecated — Char, multi-style text spans, and the SVG_ plugin/component commands for converting characters to pictures are all still available
Cross-platform font rendering differences for symbols/emoji described in the note are an OS-level reality that still applies today, independent of 4D version
